Educators can access tools instantly across panels, laptops, and phones using existing Microsoft accounts, eliminating the need for cables or additional passwords. The platform is designed to streamline digital learning environments and simplify daily classroom workflows. With upcoming remote fleet management and direct developer support, Colloquium Tech enables IT teams to manage and control entire districts from one central dashboard. The company focuses on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable solutions for modern education technology. review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Worldwide Technology (WWT), a 36-year-old global technology solutions provider, specializes in systems integration, infrastructure-cloud security, application development, artificial intelligence services, and supply chain solutions. With a dedicated workforce of over 10,000 employees and strategic partnerships with leading OEMs such as Cisco, Dell EMC, Microsoft, and NVIDIA, WWT delivers innovative infrastructure, cloud, security, and custom application services to clients across 35 countries. Our Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs)—state-of-the-art lab environments spanning over one million square feet—enable us to provide unmatched value and innovation at scale. Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work by Glassdoor and Fortune for 14 consecutive years, WWT is also ranked #6 on India’s Great Place to Work list for 2025. About The Role WorldWide Technology Holding Co, LLC. (WWT) is currently offering an exciting opportunity for a Lead / Subject Matter Expert (SME) Network Engineer on a long-term contract basis. This remote role is ideal for highly experienced network professionals who excel in designing, implementing, and leading complex network solutions within large enterprise or regulated environments. As a Lead / SME Network Engineer, you will be responsible for guiding engineering teams, developing architectural standards, and ensuring the successful delivery of network infrastructure projects. You will act as a technical authority, working closely with stakeholders and global support teams to transition solutions into operational support, ensuring alignment with organizational standards and compliance requirements. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess over 10 years of demonstrable experience in leading, designing, and deploying complex network solutions within large enterprise or regulated industries. Proven experience as a Lead Engineer on large transformational programs is essential, along with strong technical expertise across multiple network technologies. Certifications such as Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) Enterprise, FortiGate Professional, or F5 LTM/GTM at the Certified Technical Specialist level or equivalent are highly advantageous. Candidates should demonstrate excellent communication skills, ability to consolidate knowledge into comprehensive solutions, and a proactive approach to workload and project management. Responsibilities Serve as a subject matter expert in two or more network technologies, maintaining a working knowledge of additional technologies used within the organization. Scope, plan, and lead engineering efforts on large-scale transformational programs and network-led initiatives. Design, build, and deploy network infrastructure solutions that align with business requirements and architectural standards. Develop detailed low-level designs and supporting documentation to facilitate implementation and maintenance. Coordinate with global support teams to ensure smooth transition of delivered solutions into operational support environments. Ensure all network designs and implementations comply with governance, change management, and risk management policies. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to meet project objectives, providing timely updates and escalating issues as needed. Estimate workloads and delivery timelines accurately, managing project scope and resources effectively. Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve complex technical issues and improve network performance. Participate in risk assessments and ensure activities are conducted in accordance with regulatory and internal standards. Benefits Working with WWT offers a range of benefits, including competitive compensation packages, flexible remote working arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth and development. Employees gain access to cutting-edge technology projects, training resources, and a collaborative work environment that values innovation and diversity. WWT also emphasizes work-life balance and provides comprehensive health insurance, retirement plans, and wellness programs to support employee well-being. Equal Opportunity WWT is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other protected status.

review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer (Bare Metal)
review_candidates.description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com. Please note that this is a 24/7/365 team. You will be asked to select and rank your preferred shift(s) below. What You’ll Do The Customer Experience (CX) Organization at CoreWeave is dedicated to ensuring every client running AI workloads at scale has a seamless, reliable, and high-performance experience. This team supports the infrastructure that powers the AI revolution—working across data centers, hardware systems, and customer workloads to maintain the integrity of our cloud platform. The CX organization aligns closely with the internal and customer engineering teams, offering valuable insights from the field and having the chance to contribute to the CoreWeave product roadmap and development. About The Role As a Bare Metal Support Engineer , you will be responsible for supporting, operating, and maintaining CoreWeave’s extensive GPU fleet across our growing data centers in the U.S., Europe, and beyond. You will work closely with customers, data center technicians, and engineering teams to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our infrastructure. In This Role, You Will Provide high-level support for customers utilizing bare-metal GPU fleets on CoreWeave Cloud. Diagnose, triage, and investigate reported customer issues and high-priority incidents, identifying root causes and escalating when necessary. Develop a deep understanding of customer workloads and use cases to provide tailored technical support. Coordinate remote troubleshooting and hardware interventions with Data Center Technicians. Create and maintain internal documentation, including troubleshooting guides, best practices, and knowledge base articles. Participate in an on-call rotation to support production clusters and ensure operational reliability. Collaborate with engineering teams to improve hardware reliability, software stability, and system performance. Implement automation and scripting to streamline support workflows and reduce manual interventions. Perform in-depth log analysis and debugging across multiple layers of the stack (firmware, drivers, hardware). Provide feedback to internal teams on common support issues to drive continuous improvements. Work with networking teams to troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting customer workloads. Support supercomputing infrastructure running GPU workloads at scale. Drive operational excellence by refining internal processes and support methodologies. Who You Are Experience in data centers, GPU clusters, server deployments, system administration, or hardware troubleshooting. Demonstrated experience driving resolutions and continuous improvements across cross-functional environments and teams within a data center environment. Intermediate knowledge of Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, or similar), including command-line proficiency. Experience with NVIDIA GPUs, SuperMicro systems, Dell systems, high-performance computing (HPC), and large-scale data center environments. Experience in networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP) and troubleshooting tools. Hands-on experience with firmware updates, BIOS configurations, and driver management. Experience analyzing system logs and debugging issues across firmware, drivers, and hardware layers. Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Notion, or other issue-tracking and documentation platforms. Experience in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, Ansible, or similar). Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds—even if you don’t check every box. Here are a few qualities we’ve found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. You’re curious about Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized infrastructure You have strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and analytical mindset. You have excellent communication skills and a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Why CoreWeave? About At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: Be Curious at Your Core Act Like an Owner Empower Employees Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences Achieve More Together We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! The base salary range for this role is $83,000 to $145,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). What We Offer The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave Company-paid Life Insurance Voluntary supplemental life insurance Short and long-term disability insurance Flexible Spending Account Health Savings Account Tuition Reimbursement Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health Family-Forming support provided by Carrot Paid Parental Leave Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside 401(k) with a generous employer match Flexible PTO Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations A casual work environment A work culture focused on innovative disruption California Applicants California Consumer Privacy Act Equal Opportunity & Accommodations CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) , CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com. Export Control Compliance This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. review_candidates.title: Lead Technical Architect
review_candidates.description: Pay up to £96,683, plus 28.97% employer pension contributions, hybrid working, flexible hours, and great work life balance. DWP. Digital with Purpose. We are looking for Lead Technical Architects with expertise in application architecture and AI to join our AI & Innovation team. DWP Digital is delivering one of Europe's largest digital transformation programmes, creating services that support millions of people every day. We are designing modern technology solutions at scale, shaping the future of public services through AI and digital innovation. The scale of what we do is extraordinary, and our purpose is unique. We'd love you to join us. What skills, knowledge and experience will you need? Architecture design across on-prem, cloud and hybrid environments involving networking, security, presentation, middleware, database, and integration aspects. Architecture design informed through use of principles, patterns, technical radars, practices and standards. Architecture design working with project delivery teams within agile, waterfall and hybrid environments throughout the lifecycle - from concept to go-live. Translating business requirements into technical solutions with traceability that can be demonstrated to stakeholders. Architecture design through use of architecture modelling techniques and tools to devise and represent. AI enterprise products: Experience of assurance for enterprise AI productivity tooling. Enterprise products such as Copilot (including Agent Builder & Copilot Studio) and Claude Desktop. Best practice for using model harness such as Claude Code or Codex. Best practice for Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools within an large organisation. AI solution evaluation: Implement frameworks and approaches to evaluate model performance against business objectives, through the full lifecycle (including Business KPIs, Hallucination rates, Safety testing, Bias testing, Cost evaluation). Technology experience might include tools such as Promptfoo, Ragas & Langfuse. AI security: Governance, Compliance, Threats & mitigations : Experience of security governance and assurance for AI solutions, including data protection, privacy, model governance. You and your role Our Architects lead the design and governance of strategic technology solutions, working with senior stakeholders across DWP Digital to drive innovation, influence technology choices, and deliver user-centred digital services. You'll provide architectural leadership for complex programmes, developing practical solutions that balance business needs, security, scalability, and long-term value. As part of DWP's Corporate Innovation Unit, you'll help accelerate the adoption of AI and automation technologies that improve internal processes and empower colleagues to focus on higher-value work. This includes leveraging Microsoft 365 AI capabilities, Microsoft Copilot Studio and agentic AI technologies, while exploring opportunities to develop secure, scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms where needed. Details. Wages. Perks. Location: You'll join us in one of our brilliant digital hubs in Blackpool, Birmingham, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle or Sheffield, whichever is most convenient for you. Hybrid Working: We work a hybrid model - you'll spend some time working at home and some time collaborating face to face in a hub. Pay: We offer pay up to £96,683. That's £75,026 salary plus a Government Digital and Data Allowance of up to £21,667 subject to our assessment of your capability at interview. Pension: You'll get a brilliant civil service pension with employer contributions worth 28.97%, worth up to £21,735 per year. Holidays: A generous leave package starting at 26 days rising to 31 days over time. You can also take up to 3 extra days off a month on flexi-time. You'll also get all the usual public holidays. We have a broad benefits package built around your work-life balance which includes: Flexible working including flexible hours and flex-friendly policies Time off volunteering and charitable giving Bring your authentic self to work with 'I Can Be Me in DWP' Discounts and savings on shopping, fun days out and more Interest-free loans to buy a bike or a season ticket, so it's even easier for you to get to work and start making a difference Sports and social activities Professional development, coaching, mentoring and career progression opportunities. And We Have An Award-winning Environment And Culture DWP have been recognised as 2024 Diversity Employer of the Year at the Computing Women in Tech Excellence awards Diverse and Inclusive Leadership at Digital Leaders Awards 2024 Commended as Best Place to Work in Digital category in the Computing Digital Technology Leaders awards 2025 Recognised as one of the Best Public Sector Employers at 2025 Women In Tech Employer Awards Process We know your time is valuable so our application and selection process is just two stages: Apply: complete your application on Civil Service Jobs. There'll be full instructions when you click through. Interview: a two-stage interview online. Click APPLY for more information and to start your application.

The ideal candidate has deep roots in the Telecom/SaaS industry, an established network of local System Integrators (SIs), and the ability to close complex B2B deals — with the drive to hunt, the discipline to farm, and the mindset to deliver consistent business outcomes. Roles & Responsibilities ●New Business Development: identify and acquire new B2B clients in Hyderabad and surrounding regions, selling Cloud PBX, DID/SIP Trunking, MS Teams Direct Routing, Bulk SMS/WhatsApp API, and Contact Center solutions. ● Consultative Selling: understand client communication pain points and propose tailored V oIP/Cloud Telephony architecture. ● Pipeline Management: own the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation and closure, consistently achieving monthly/quarterly revenue targets. ● CXO Engagement: build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives (CTOs, CIOs, IT Heads) and key decision-makers. ●Account Growth: grow existing accounts strategically while identifying new acquisition opportunities. Partner Onboarding: identify, recruit, and onboard new channel partners, resellers, and System Integrators in the region. Partner Enablement: train partners on product USPs, pricing models, and competitive positioning. Joint Go-to-Market: collaborate with partners on joint sales campaigns and close leads generated through the channel network. Strategy & Reporting: analyze market trends and competitor activity across AP/Telangana, and maintain accurate CRM data (Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho) for forecasting. Eligibility Criteria ● 5–10 years of proven B2B sales experience, specifically in Telecom, ISP, Cloud Telephony, or SaaS. ●Strong understanding of V oIP technologies (SIP, PRI, Hosted PBX) and CPaaS products (SMS, V oice API, WhatsApp Business API). ●Established network of corporate connections and channel partners in Hyderabad/Telangana. ●Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Telugu/Hindi. ●Proven ability to negotiate contracts and manage complex commercial discussions. ●Bonus: experience selling Microsoft Teams Direct Routing or Zoom Phone solutions. ●Bonus: existing relationships with IT Heads of major IT parks/hubs in Hyderabad (e.g., Hitec City, Gachibowli).

review_candidates.title: Senior Outcomes Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job #: req38237 Organization: World Bank Sector: Economics Grade: GG Term Duration: 2 years Recruitment Type: International Recruitment Location: Washington, DC,United States Required Language(s): English Preferred Language(s) Closing Date: 9/16/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC Description Do you want to build a career that is truly worthwhile? The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty and promoting shared prosperity. With 189 member countries and more than 120 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org. The Delivery Unit translates corporate priorities and outcome commitments into management routines that support implementation, problem-solving, accountability, and course correction. Its work connects targets, portfolio intelligence, operational evidence, delivery constraints, and leadership decisions. Core instruments include sector and regional stocktakes, target monitoring, delivery analytics, and AI-enabled tools that help teams move from storing data to steering performance. The Senior Economist / Senior Outcomes Specialist will lead major elements of this agenda. The position will devote approximately 50 percent of time to sector-focused stocktakes, 30 percent to managing the substantive work of the High-Level Council on Jobs, and 20 percent to the development, testing, evaluation, and research of AI-enabled outcomes tools. The role requires a combination of development economics, delivery-unit practice, advanced quantitative analysis, technology and product fluency, behavioral science, and senior stakeholder management. Duties And Accountabilities Lead sector-focused stocktakes and delivery reviews (approximately 50 percent) Design and manage a systematic program of sector-focused stocktakes that enables senior management to assess whether strategies, portfolios, and implementation pathways are on track to deliver agreed outcomes. Establish the analytical architecture for each stocktake, including outcome questions, indicators, targets, baselines, benchmarks, portfolio cuts, trajectories, scenarios, and evidence standards. Integrate operational, financial, portfolio, country, sector, evaluative, and external data to identify performance trends, delivery gaps, implementation bottlenecks, concentration risks, and opportunities to improve impact, scale, additionality, and value for money. Apply delivery-unit methods to convert evidence into a small number of management choices, agreed actions, accountable owners, milestones, escalation points, and follow-up routines; track whether actions are implemented and whether they change performance. Diagnose the institutional and behavioral drivers of delivery, including incentives, decision rights, coordination failures, attention constraints, risk perceptions, cognitive biases, and the routines that shape day-to-day implementation choices. Facilitate structured problem-solving sessions with sector, regional, country, IFC, MIGA, and corporate counterparts; challenge assumptions constructively and build ownership of corrective action. Prepare concise, decision-oriented briefs, dashboards, presentations, speaking points, decision records, and action trackers for senior management reviews. Strengthen the stocktake methodology and its links to sector strategies, country programs, the WBG Scorecard, corporate outcome targets, Target Map, results narratives, and other institutional performance systems. Synthesize cross-sector and cross-regional findings into operational guidance, management recommendations, and reusable institutional knowledge. Deliver advanced economic, quantitative, and portfolio analytics Apply economic, econometric, statistical, and mixed-methods analysis to understand the drivers of outcomes and distinguish implementation constraints from design, measurement, or reporting issues. Develop and interpret benchmarks, progress-to-maturity curves, forecasts, counterfactuals where feasible, scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk models that enable management to judge whether delivery is on track. Use reproducible analytical workflows to clean, link, validate, and analyze large administrative and operational datasets; document assumptions, uncertainty, limitations, and data-quality risks transparently. Translate complex quantitative findings into clear operational implications and targeted actions for non-technical decision-makers. Manage the High-Level Council on Jobs (approximately 30 percent) Manage the Council's work program, translating strategic direction from the Chair, WBG leadership, and members into a focused analytical agenda, sequenced deliverables, and disciplined follow-through. Coordinate substantive engagement with Council members and their offices, including consultations, agenda development, briefings, meeting preparation, records of discussion, action tracking, and implementation follow-up. Lead preparation of analytical notes, evidence syntheses, policy options, presentations, speeches, and knowledge products on the quantity and quality of jobs and the pathways through which development interventions support them. Connect the Council's work to WBG country and sector strategies, private-sector development, the More and Better-Paid Jobs framework, jobs measurement, corporate targets, and operational delivery. Coordinate contributions across WBG units and external partners, reconcile different institutional perspectives, surface unresolved choices, and sustain momentum between high-level engagements. Use behavioral insights to strengthen coalition-building, framing, uptake, and follow-through, recognizing how incentives, norms, identity, trust, and decision context influence collective action. Advance AI-enabled outcomes tools, evaluation, and research (approximately 20 percent) Support the end-to-end product cycle for AI-enabled outcomes and delivery tools: problem definition, user research, requirements, data and model design, prototyping, testing, evaluation, deployment, adoption, monitoring, and iteration. Translate operational workflows into well-defined use cases, user stories, technical specifications, evaluation questions, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs. Design and conduct structured user testing and product analytics with operational teams and decision-makers, assessing accuracy, usability, relevance, decision usefulness, trust, adoption, workflow integration, equity, and scalability. Contribute to rigorous validation and evaluation, including benchmark datasets, error analysis, human-in-the-loop protocols, experiments or quasi-experimental approaches where appropriate, and comparisons against existing practice. Apply behavioral science to product design and adoption by testing how defaults, salience, feedback, friction, choice architecture, and social norms affect use and decision quality. Work with economists, data scientists, software and product teams, evaluators, operational specialists, and academic partners to refine methods and translate research into usable tools. Ensure appropriate human oversight and transparency concerning data provenance, uncertainty, limitations, privacy, security, fairness, bias, and responsible AI risks. Strengthen institutional learning and partnerships Build strong working relationships across Global Practices, Regions, IFC, MIGA, OPCS, IEG, ITS, DEC, the Department for Outcomes, and external partners. Develop methodological notes, case studies, evaluation products, executive briefs, and operational learning materials connecting stocktake findings, delivery practice, the jobs agenda, behavioral insights, and AI-enabled analytics. Represent the work in technical discussions and selected senior-level engagements, exercising sound judgment and escalating strategic, political, reputational, data, technology, and quality risks as appropriate. review_candidates.title: Programmamanager
review_candidates.description: Over deze vacature Als Programmamanager bij TMC ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, aansturen en beheersen van integrale programma’s binnen onder andere infrastructuur, mobiliteit, energietransitie, waterveiligheid en gebiedsontwikkeling. Het gaat om programma’s waarin meerdere projecten en deelopgaven parallel lopen en waarin bestuurlijke, maatschappelijke en technische belangen nauw met elkaar verweven zijn. Je stuurt op samenhang tussen projecten, bewaakt de strategische doelstellingen en zorgt voor een effectieve governance- en besluitvormingsstructuur. Daarbij ben je verantwoordelijk voor het programma als geheel: van scope en fasering tot financiën, risico’s, capaciteit en kwaliteit. Je fungeert als sparringpartner voor opdrachtgevers en bestuurders en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar heldere keuzes en concrete resultaten. Je werkt aan opdrachten bij bijvoorbeeld (lokale) overheden, provincies, waterschappen, netbeheerders en publieke organisaties. De programma’s en projecten zijn uiteenlopend, maar jouw rol is steeds gericht op integraal sturen en het creëren van overzicht en rust in een dynamische omgeving. Je begrijpt de technische en inhoudelijke context voldoende om strategische afwegingen te maken, zonder zelf de inhoudelijk specialist te hoeven zijn. Binnen TMC werk je met erkende programma- en projectmanagementmethodieken, zoals MSP, IPMA, PRINCE2 of vergelijkbare werkwijzen. Je past deze pragmatisch toe en krijgt de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen op het gebied van programmasturing, governance en leiderschap, passend bij jouw ambities. Wat we van jou verwachten Wij zoeken een Programmamanager die strategisch kan denken en tegelijkertijd oog houdt voor uitvoering. Je bent in staat om complexiteit te reduceren, richting te geven en verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen. Je voelt je comfortabel in een bestuurlijke omgeving en weet stakeholders op verschillende niveaus effectief te betrekken. Je Herkent Jezelf In Het Volgende Je hebt affiniteit met civiele techniek en het ruimtelijk domein. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van programma’s of complexe projecten. Je bent bekend met programma- en projectmanagementmethodieken (zoals MSP, IPMA, PRINCE2 of vergelijkbaar). Je hebt ervaring met sturen op samenhang, governance, financiën, risico’s, scope en kwaliteit. Je hebt affiniteit met strategische doelstellingen vertalen naar uitvoerbare programma’s. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en bestuurlijke communicatie. Je bent analytisch, gestructureerd en besluitvaardig. Technische expertise is een pré. Jouw vaardigheden op het gebied van inhoudelijk begrip en interesse zijn doorslaggevend. Het vermogen om integraal te sturen, overzicht te houden en mensen en belangen te verbinden, maakt jou succesvol in deze rol. Wat je van ons kunt verwachten Bij TMC Geloven We Dat Jij Het Beste Uit Jezelf Kunt Halen Wanneer Je De Juiste Begeleiding, Vrijheid En Ontwikkelmogelijkheden Krijgt. Daarom Bieden We Je Niet Alleen Afwisselende Projecten, Maar Ook Uitstekende Voorwaarden Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd met een marktconform salaris op basis van jouw ervaring en expertise. Een transparant beloningsmodel met individuele winstdeling, waarbij je precies weet hoe jouw tarief is opgebouwd en hier inspraak in hebt. Een opleidingsbudget (t.w.v. €2.200 euro per jaar) dat je naar eigen inzicht kunt besteden aan trainingen, opleidingen of andere ontwikkelactiviteiten. Samenwerking en kennisdeling met ervaren en gemotiveerde professionals binnen je eigen Business Cell, met daarnaast toegang tot kennis, ervaring en samenwerking met specialisten uit andere Business Cells. Zo biedt TMC een ruim netwerk aan professionals uit diverse specialismen. Toegang tot ons TMC Entrepreneurial Lab, waar je je eigen ideeën en projecten tot leven kunt brengen.

new_matches.title: Senior Outcomes Specialist
new_matches.description: Job #: req38237 Organization: World Bank Sector: Economics Grade: GG Term Duration: 2 years Recruitment Type: International Recruitment Location: Washington, DC,United States Required Language(s): English Preferred Language(s) Closing Date: 9/16/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC Description Do you want to build a career that is truly worthwhile? The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty and promoting shared prosperity. With 189 member countries and more than 120 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org. The Delivery Unit translates corporate priorities and outcome commitments into management routines that support implementation, problem-solving, accountability, and course correction. Its work connects targets, portfolio intelligence, operational evidence, delivery constraints, and leadership decisions. Core instruments include sector and regional stocktakes, target monitoring, delivery analytics, and AI-enabled tools that help teams move from storing data to steering performance. The Senior Economist / Senior Outcomes Specialist will lead major elements of this agenda. The position will devote approximately 50 percent of time to sector-focused stocktakes, 30 percent to managing the substantive work of the High-Level Council on Jobs, and 20 percent to the development, testing, evaluation, and research of AI-enabled outcomes tools. The role requires a combination of development economics, delivery-unit practice, advanced quantitative analysis, technology and product fluency, behavioral science, and senior stakeholder management. Duties And Accountabilities Lead sector-focused stocktakes and delivery reviews (approximately 50 percent) Design and manage a systematic program of sector-focused stocktakes that enables senior management to assess whether strategies, portfolios, and implementation pathways are on track to deliver agreed outcomes. Establish the analytical architecture for each stocktake, including outcome questions, indicators, targets, baselines, benchmarks, portfolio cuts, trajectories, scenarios, and evidence standards. Integrate operational, financial, portfolio, country, sector, evaluative, and external data to identify performance trends, delivery gaps, implementation bottlenecks, concentration risks, and opportunities to improve impact, scale, additionality, and value for money. Apply delivery-unit methods to convert evidence into a small number of management choices, agreed actions, accountable owners, milestones, escalation points, and follow-up routines; track whether actions are implemented and whether they change performance. Diagnose the institutional and behavioral drivers of delivery, including incentives, decision rights, coordination failures, attention constraints, risk perceptions, cognitive biases, and the routines that shape day-to-day implementation choices. Facilitate structured problem-solving sessions with sector, regional, country, IFC, MIGA, and corporate counterparts; challenge assumptions constructively and build ownership of corrective action. Prepare concise, decision-oriented briefs, dashboards, presentations, speaking points, decision records, and action trackers for senior management reviews. Strengthen the stocktake methodology and its links to sector strategies, country programs, the WBG Scorecard, corporate outcome targets, Target Map, results narratives, and other institutional performance systems. Synthesize cross-sector and cross-regional findings into operational guidance, management recommendations, and reusable institutional knowledge. Deliver advanced economic, quantitative, and portfolio analytics Apply economic, econometric, statistical, and mixed-methods analysis to understand the drivers of outcomes and distinguish implementation constraints from design, measurement, or reporting issues. Develop and interpret benchmarks, progress-to-maturity curves, forecasts, counterfactuals where feasible, scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk models that enable management to judge whether delivery is on track. Use reproducible analytical workflows to clean, link, validate, and analyze large administrative and operational datasets; document assumptions, uncertainty, limitations, and data-quality risks transparently. Translate complex quantitative findings into clear operational implications and targeted actions for non-technical decision-makers. Manage the High-Level Council on Jobs (approximately 30 percent) Manage the Council's work program, translating strategic direction from the Chair, WBG leadership, and members into a focused analytical agenda, sequenced deliverables, and disciplined follow-through. Coordinate substantive engagement with Council members and their offices, including consultations, agenda development, briefings, meeting preparation, records of discussion, action tracking, and implementation follow-up. Lead preparation of analytical notes, evidence syntheses, policy options, presentations, speeches, and knowledge products on the quantity and quality of jobs and the pathways through which development interventions support them. Connect the Council's work to WBG country and sector strategies, private-sector development, the More and Better-Paid Jobs framework, jobs measurement, corporate targets, and operational delivery. Coordinate contributions across WBG units and external partners, reconcile different institutional perspectives, surface unresolved choices, and sustain momentum between high-level engagements. Use behavioral insights to strengthen coalition-building, framing, uptake, and follow-through, recognizing how incentives, norms, identity, trust, and decision context influence collective action. Advance AI-enabled outcomes tools, evaluation, and research (approximately 20 percent) Support the end-to-end product cycle for AI-enabled outcomes and delivery tools: problem definition, user research, requirements, data and model design, prototyping, testing, evaluation, deployment, adoption, monitoring, and iteration. Translate operational workflows into well-defined use cases, user stories, technical specifications, evaluation questions, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs. Design and conduct structured user testing and product analytics with operational teams and decision-makers, assessing accuracy, usability, relevance, decision usefulness, trust, adoption, workflow integration, equity, and scalability. Contribute to rigorous validation and evaluation, including benchmark datasets, error analysis, human-in-the-loop protocols, experiments or quasi-experimental approaches where appropriate, and comparisons against existing practice. Apply behavioral science to product design and adoption by testing how defaults, salience, feedback, friction, choice architecture, and social norms affect use and decision quality. Work with economists, data scientists, software and product teams, evaluators, operational specialists, and academic partners to refine methods and translate research into usable tools. Ensure appropriate human oversight and transparency concerning data provenance, uncertainty, limitations, privacy, security, fairness, bias, and responsible AI risks. Strengthen institutional learning and partnerships Build strong working relationships across Global Practices, Regions, IFC, MIGA, OPCS, IEG, ITS, DEC, the Department for Outcomes, and external partners. Develop methodological notes, case studies, evaluation products, executive briefs, and operational learning materials connecting stocktake findings, delivery practice, the jobs agenda, behavioral insights, and AI-enabled analytics. Represent the work in technical discussions and selected senior-level engagements, exercising sound judgment and escalating strategic, political, reputational, data, technology, and quality risks as appropriate. Reporting and Working Relationships The Senior Economist / Senior Outcomes Specialist will report to the Manager, Delivery, Department for Outcomes, or another designated manager within the Department. The role will work closely with sector and regional leadership, country teams, IFC and MIGA counterparts, corporate units, jobs specialists, economists, behavioral scientists, data scientists, engineers, product teams, evaluators, and external partners. The position requires a high degree of autonomy, discretion, responsiveness, and quality control in work prepared for WBG senior management and high-level external stakeholders. Selection Criteria Advanced degree, preferably Master's or PhD, in economics, behavioral economics, public policy, public administration, international development, data science, statistics, political economy, business administration, or a related field. Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience in development economics, delivery-unit practice, sector or portfolio analytics, institutional performance, results and outcomes, jobs, technology-enabled delivery, or multilateral advisory work. Demonstrated experience working with or advising a government delivery unit, center-of-government function, corporate delivery office, implementation unit, or comparable performance-management structure, including the use of routines for problem-solving, escalation, accountability, and course correction. Strong economist or outcomes-specialist profile, with the ability to connect sector strategy, financing, portfolio composition, implementation, institutional incentives, and measurable outcomes. Advanced quantitative skills, including demonstrated experience with statistical and econometric analysis, forecasting, scenario analysis, benchmarking, data validation, and the integration of large administrative or operational datasets. Proficiency in at least one analytical language or environment such as Python, R, Stata, or SQL is highly desirable. Strong technology and product fluency, including experience with AI or machine learning, large language models, natural language processing, predictive analytics, data visualization, digital platforms, product development, user testing, or technology evaluation. Demonstrated ability to assess the validity and operational usefulness of analytical or AI-enabled tools, including accuracy, error patterns, uncertainty, data provenance, human oversight, responsible AI, and adoption in real workflows. Knowledge of behavioral science and behavioral economics, including the ability to diagnose how incentives, norms, cognitive biases, attention, trust, risk perception, defaults, friction, and choice architecture shape implementation and decision-making. Experience applying behavioral insights, experimentation, or user-centered research to public policy, institutional reform, or technology adoption is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience designing or supporting senior-level stocktakes, delivery reviews, portfolio reviews, strategy reviews, or comparable management processes and translating findings into actions, owners, milestones, and follow-up. Substantive understanding of the jobs agenda and experience supporting high-level councils, commissions, advisory groups, boards, or complex multi-stakeholder initiatives. Strong understanding of the multilateral development system and the WBG operating model, including country and sector engagement, public- and private-sector instruments, corporate priorities, and development effectiveness debates. Exceptional writing, synthesis, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate complex analytical and technical issues to senior decision-makers and build alignment across disciplines and institutions. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-visibility workstreams, influence without formal authority, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality work under tight timelines. Fluency in English required; additional languages are desirable. WBG Culture Attributes Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: A. Leadership, Strategy & Planning Focused on leading people, aligning operational direction with corporate goals, and ensuring continuous improvement. Provide strategic leadership and direction to all plant personnel to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the Waste-to-Energy (WTE) Plant, including coordination across operations, maintenance, and support functions. Translate corporate objectives into actionable operational plans, ensuring alignment of team goals with organizational targets. Oversee the development and execution of annual operating plans, budgets, and performance targets while monitoring progress and implementing corrective actions where necessary. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance plant reliability, process efficiency, and cost effectiveness. B. Regulatory, Safety & Compliance Encompasses compliance with ISO standards, DOE, SWCorp, and occupational safety regulations. Ensure full compliance with all QHSE standards, DOE and SWCorp regulations, and other relevant statutory requirements. Cultivate a strong safety culture through proactive leadership, risk management, and enforcement of zero-LTI (Lost Time Injury) commitment. Act as the key representative of the plant in dealings with regulatory authorities, clients, corporate management, and local stakeholders. Build and maintain constructive relationships with government agencies (DOE, SWCorp, JPSPN, TNB), local councils, and technical partners/OEMs. C. Financial, Operational & Resource Management Focused on cost control, budgeting, and resource optimization to ensure operational efficiency. Manage plant operational and maintenance budgets to achieve financial efficiency and accountability. Control key operational cost drivers, including energy, chemical consumption, and waste handling, ensuring optimal resource utilization. Review and endorse major expenditures, maintenance programs, and procurement activities in line with corporate policies and approval limits. Monitor plant performance through regular review of operational data and KPI dashboards, ensuring timely identification and resolution of performance gaps. D. Human Capital & Organizational Development Focused on workforce management, competency building and team culture. Lead workforce planning, recruitment, and competency development to maintain a capable and motivated operations team. Promote teamwork, accountability, and professional discipline to strengthen overall plant culture and staff retention REQUIREMENTS: 1) Education : Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Process Engineering from a recognised institution. 2) Possession of a 1st and 2nd Class Steam Engineer Certificate (DOSH-registered) is mandatory. 3) Additional qualification in Energy Management, Environmental Engineering, or Industrial Safety will be an added advantage. 4)Technical Mastery: a) Solid knowledge of engineering practices, thermal processes, and power/WtE plant operations. b) Strong leadership in managing multidisciplinary teams across operations, maintenance, and ESH. c) Well-versed in DOE, DOSH, SWCorp, and JPSPN compliance requirements. d) Proficient in English and Bahasa Malaysia; able to communicate effectively with teams, contractors, and regulators. e) Experienced in environmental control and monitoring systems (eSWIS, CEMS, OER, waste management). f) Skilled in risk management, HIRADC, emergency response, and ISO 9001/14001/45001 standards. g) Financially astute with experience in budgeting, cost control, and plant performance tracking. 5) Experience : Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in power generation, thermal process, or renewable energy operations, including at least 5 years in a managerial or supervisory capacity in a Waste-to-Energy, biomass, or thermal power plant environment.

new_matches.title: Network Planning Engineer - Overland Park, KS
new_matches.description: Company Overview Cogent Communications is a global, Tier 1 facilities-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high-speed Internet access and Ethernet transport services. Cogent's facilities-based, all-optical IP network backbone provides IP services globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. A competitive base salary and a full benefits package including; Health, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), Short- and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Parental Leave, 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program. Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period. Job Summary The Network Planning Engineer is responsible for the planning and engineering of DWDM optical transport networks across major metropolitan markets in North America. This role evaluates customer orders, determines network augmentation requirements, and prepares the technical documentation needed to support network growth and expansion. The Network Planning Engineer works closely with Network Operations, Field Services, and Sales Engineering to ensure the network is provisioned ahead of demand, and plays a key role in analyzing traffic trends and driving automation to improve planning efficiency. Compensation: [Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $70,000 - $90,000 Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Plan and engineer DWDM 10GE, 100GE, and 400GE optical transport networks in major metropolitan markets across North America. Evaluate and approve customer orders and determine network augmentation requirements. Prepare Bill of Materials (BoM) and Statement of Work (SOW) documentation for complex network growth and expansion projects. Analyze traffic patterns to inform network planning and future growth strategies. Drive automation through the development of network planning tools. Collaborate with Network Operations, Field Services, and Sales Engineering teams to support network build-outs and augmentations. Maintain accurate records of network capacity, inventory, and forecasted growth. Support the resolution of network capacity issues in coordination with cross-functional teams. Qualifications Planning and engineering of DWDM 10GE, 100GE, and 400GE optical transport networks in major metropolitan markets in North America. Evaluate & approve customer orders and determine network augmentation requirements. Prepare Bill of Materials (BoM) and Statement of Work (SOW) for complex network growth and expansion projects. Analyze traffic patterns to drive network inference into future growth strategies. Drive automation through network tool development. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Familiarity with 10GE, 100GE, and 400GE technologies. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret traffic patterns and forecast network growth. Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Proficient In The Following Areas Knowledge of optical transport network architecture and design principles. Understanding of network capacity planning and augmentation processes. Familiarity with network automation and scripting tools (e.g., Python) is a PLUS. Experience with network planning or inventory management software is a PLUS. Knowledge of IP/MPLS networking concepts is a PLUS. Physical Requirements Remains in a sitting/stationary position continually or almost continually during the work day Operates a computer and performs desk-based computer tasks continually; frequently viewing a computer screen Rarely lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling objects and/or equipment that weighs up to 50 pounds NOTE: This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. By submitting an application or resume for this position, I understand that is an in-office position. To apply for the Network Planning Engineer position, please submit your resume to https://cogentco.com/en/about-cogent/careers Candidates only. No Recruiters, please! Cogent Communications is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The grid station focuses on safe, efficient, and consistent power flow across high-voltage infrastructure. Team members work with modern equipment, established procedures, and regulatory standards to ensure system stability and minimal downtime. The environment supports technical growth, adherence to safety practices, and collaboration among engineering and operations staff. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Electrical Engineer role located in Bahawalnagar. The Electrical Engineer will oversee the operation and maintenance of 132KV grid station equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and control panels. Daily responsibilities include monitoring power flows, performing inspections and diagnostic tests, coordinating corrective and preventive maintenance, and responding to faults and outages to restore service safely and promptly. The role also involves reviewing technical documentation, supporting electrical design improvements, ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards, and collaborating with operations teams and field technicians to optimize reliability and performance. Candidates should possess skills in Electrical Design for power infrastructure and related systems. Candidates should possess experience in Power Distribution, including grid operations and load management. Familiarity with high-voltage equipment, protection relays, and substation safety procedures. Ability to interpret technical drawings, single-line diagrams, and equipment specifications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and capacity to work in shift-based operations. Effective communication and teamwork skills, with commitment to safe work practices. Relevant professional certifications or prior grid/substation experience are an advantage.

new_matches.title: ERSOU - ROCU - Police Staff Scale SO1/2 - Intel Analyst (ROCTA)
new_matches.description: Bedfordshire Police Police Staff Permanent Full Time ERSOU - Regional Organised Crime Unit Agile, Stevenage SO1/2 £39,276 - £44,700 37 The Role An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the Regional Organised Crime Threat Assessment Unit (ROCTA). ROCTA is responsible for scoping, understanding and presenting the threat to the Eastern region from serious and organised crime: identifying opportunities; supporting ERSOU departments operationally; and presenting recommendations to Force and Regional Tasking Forums. We are seeking experienced and skilled analysts (or assistant analysts) who are looking for new and exciting experiences as a ROCTA Intelligence Analyst. This role involves working as part of a team to ensure the Eastern region has the best understanding of serious and organised criminals impacting upon the area. The Successful Applicant Will Interrogate a range of databases and systems to identify intelligence of value to departments or individuals. Conduct daily scanning as required to assist in understanding and identification of threat, risk and vulnerability. Be responsible for maintaining understanding the regional threat for a specified area(s) of the ERSOU Control Strategy and writing regular strategic products to inform regional and national colleagues. This includes contributing to the ERSOU Strategic Assessment, writing a Quarterly Threat Assessment, and other bespoke products as required. Present information and analysis in ROCU, regional and national forums. Research, collate and analyse intelligence to map OCGs in the Eastern region, and support forces with delivery of OCGM, working as a force liaison and attending regular meetings. Undertake project work, taking responsibility for scoping, analysing and presenting findings in an appropriate format whether written, visual or verbal. Assist in delivery of SOC System Tasking in the region including assessment and moderation of regional threats using MoRiLE on APMIS. Liaise with forces and partners to promote and enable intelligence sharing across agencies. Produce and maintain Microsoft Power BI dashboards. Entry Level Requirements Ability to work with Windows based software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) Experience in working with customised databases and computer packages Well-developed numeric, analytical and research skills Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal Flexible approach to work and ability to self-motivate Desirable Criteria IPP Intelligence Analyst Accreditation Completed Analytical training Experience in producing Power BI dashboards The post is Agile working between a base in Hertfordshire and with opportunities to work from home. There is a requirement to travel across the region on occasion therefore a full current Driving Licence is required. Interested? Please see the attached Role Profile for further details including essential and desirable criteria. ERSOU – Who Are We And What We Do Created in 2010, ERSOU is funded by the seven police forces that make up the eastern region, with Bedfordshire Police being the lead force. ERSOU is the Eastern Region Special Operations Unit, that oversees and delivers a regional level response to Serious and Organised Crime, and Counter Terrorism Policing for the Forces in the Eastern Region. ERSOU is made up of both Officers and Police Staff from across the entire region and works closely with the 7 Forces and National Partners. The departments are unique, in that they offer opportunities to work and develop individuals professionally in specialist areas, often delivering capabilities that are provided by local forces. Working for ERSOU presents a fantastic opportunity for you to learn and develop within a unique law enforcement community whose staff and officers are dedicated to protecting the public from the threat of terrorism and serious and organised crime. We are committed to building a leadership team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from individuals who are currently underrepresented at senior levels, including women, Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic candidates, disabled people, and those from LGBTQ+ communities. We value the unique perspectives and experience that diverse leadership brings and welcome candidates who can help us drive inclusive policing and community engagement. ERSOU As An Employer Can Offer Blue light card discounts Generous pension scheme Opportunities to get involved with networking groups such as the network of women, LGBTQ+, parent, carers, health, and wellbeing. VETTING Applicants must hold or be prepared to undergo Management Vetting (5 years residency criteria), Security Clearance (5 years residency criteria) Due to the sensitive nature of these checks, we are not able to supply feedback should clearance be declined. For Further information Email us at ASK.ERSOU@beds.police.uk , emails will be forwarded on to the relevant recruiting manager and we will endeavour to reply within 3 working days. Additional Information All internal applicants must have successfully completed their probationary period to apply for this role. An interview will be required for all candidates who pass the paper sift. Internal applicants within Bedfordshire Police, Cambridgeshire Constabulary or Hertfordshire Constabulary (BCH), should upload either a CV or provide relevant skills, experiences and qualifications on Word/PDF document. This vacancy is live to those at risk of redundancy and will remain open to redeployees until the conditional offer stage throughout the recruitment process. Redeployees will take priority over other applicants at any point during the recruitment process up until conditional offer. If a redeployee is successful and accepts an offer, they will remain on their home force’s terms and conditions. The role is open to experienced Intelligence Development Officers The Sensitive Intelligence Unit is a fascinating and exciting place to work. The department is a unique function within Policing and across the Eastern Region, providing specialist intelligence support to ROCU and Force led operations as well as supporting partner agencies in their fight against serious and organised crime. The SIU is dedicated to supporting operations tackling the highest harm and threat areas, across multiple crime types, exploiting and enhancing intelligence from multiple sensitive data sources in order to provide key stakeholders with the best opportunities to conduct enforcement, recover assets, seize criminal commodity and bring offenders to justice. We provide intelligence support to Crime In Action investigations (kidnap and extortion) as well as supporting the prevention, mitigation and management of Threats to Life (TTL) in order to safeguard vulnerable people. Managing intelligence against tasked operations across the Eastern Region, you will gain first-hand knowledge of Serious and Organised Crime detection and disruption techniques and conduct intelligence collection against Organised Crime Groups (OCG’s) involved in firearms and drugs importation/supply, organised immigration crime/human trafficking, modern day slavery, child sexual exploitation, cyber enabled criminality and financial crime across the region. The work conducted by the SIU delivers significant operational results day in day out. The SIU can often be an exhilarating and fast-moving working environment where innovation, problem solving and the use of the latest technology and intelligence techniques are utilised to keep up with the ever-growing complexity and sophistication of serious organised crime. You can expect a varied and fulfilling career within this business area, with no two days ever being quite the same. Your work will be fundamental in contributing to the impressive results that make the headlines and your role will be integral in the disruption of organised crime in the Eastern Region. The role involves undertaking an 8-week rotational shift pattern as the SIU operates between the hours of 8am and 6pm. Tackling serious and organised criminals requires applicants to be able to be flexible to meet operational demands (sometimes at short notice). ABOUT DECISION LAB Decision Lab is an insights-driven consulting firm helping organisations in Southeast Asia turn opportunity into intentional, innovation-led growth by making better commercial decisions in fast-changing markets. We attract some of the most ambitious people in our industry, and we have built the firm around them: a place for ambitious, curious minds to do work that changes what clients decide, and to go further here than they would elsewhere. ABOUT THE ROLE You will lead Decision Lab's Finance & Banking practice and own its P&L. The practice works with leading banks, insurers, consumer-finance businesses and fintechs across Vietnam and the region. Our thesis is straightforward: the race for new customers is largely over, and the next decade of banking growth comes from relationship value, meaning primary status, daily usage, and the affluent and mass-affluent segments that carry the economics. That shift changes the decisions on a bank CEO's desk, and those are the decisions we work on. Our work spans primary-relationship and CASA driver studies, brand health tied to commercial outcomes, affluent and wealth proposition testing, and customer experience measurement. We publish an annual Bank Customer Satisfaction Rankings, an independent external benchmark banks cannot generate from their own dashboards, alongside syndicated research on the financial decision journey. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE IS ONE OF OUR GROWTH PILLARS, AND IT IS WHERE WE WANT THIS HIRE TO ADD CAPABILITY Digital transformation is now table stakes in Vietnamese banking, and satisfaction has become the competitive battleground. Our own rankings put the top four banks within five points of each other. Clients are moving from tracking satisfaction to diagnosing journeys and acting on drivers. We have the foundations: an established satisfaction benchmark, a partnership with Alchemer, and working relationships with several specialist CX platform vendors. What we want is someone who deepens that competency inside the team, bringing methodological confidence across the full arc of a CX programme, and building it into how the practice sells and delivers. WHAT YOU WILL OWN • The Finance & Banking practice P&L: revenue, margin, growth • Sector strategy and the commercial direction of the practice • Senior client relationships across banking, insurance, consumer finance and fintech, as the trusted adviser clients call first • New business: pipeline, proposals and pricing • Deepening Decision Lab's CX capability and converting it into client work • Growing paid engagements from our satisfaction rankings and syndicated finance intelligence • Quality and commercial oversight of the practice's major engagements • Building the practice's leadership bench, developing project leaders rather than only managing analysts • Method and innovation in the sector: new approaches, AI-enabled research, and better answers reached faster • Decision Lab's authority in the sector through thought leadership and industry visibility WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • A strong financial-services background, built inside a bank, insurer or consumer-finance business, or advising them from an insights, strategy or consulting firm • 8+ years of relevant experience, including 2 to 3 years at a leading market research firm. Agency-side experience is essential: it is where commercial leadership, proposal ownership and P&L discipline are built • Functional depth in insights, strategy or customer experience, and the judgement to know which of the three a client problem actually needs • Hands-on experience with customer experience research: designing it, running it, and turning the results into decisions clients act on • Evidence you can convert credibility into commercial results: proposals won, relationships grown, revenue built • Comfort owning a P&L and being measured on it • The instinct to build a practice strategy rather than execute someone else's WHAT YOU WILL GET • P&L ownership of an established practice with a strong client base and an independent public benchmark behind it • Direct access to senior decision-makers across Vietnam's financial-services sector • Autonomy to shape the practice's commercial direction • A total target salary built from monthly salary, bonus at target, and a monthly employer contribution to a long-term savings account in your name, run with Dragon Capital • A performance bonus weighted towards the commercial results you own, paid quarterly • 17 days' annual leave, rising with tenure, plus recharge days and a protected recovery day after any project that took your weekend • Private health insurance • A personal learning budget, AI tooling and leadership training • One day a week working from home, and pre-approved days working from your hometown • A collaborative workspace at The Sentry, Ho Chi Minh City
